result.topic_en: Calculations in linear elasticity: the variation of the strain-energy integral in terms of stresses and strain components, the transformation of strain components under a rotation of coordinates, and the elastic potential with Lamé constants (noting Poisson's λ=μ and Wertheim's λ=2μ).
result.transcription:
[-$\delta\Omega$-] $= \iiint \partial x\partial y\partial z \Big( N_1 \delta\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} + N_2 \delta\frac{\partial v}{\partial y} + N_3 \delta\frac{\partial w}{\partial z} + T_1 \Big(\delta\Big(\frac{\partial w}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial u}{\partial z}\Big)$ $\Big)$
$\iiint \partial x\partial y\partial z\, \delta\Omega$
$\Omega = \iiint F\Big(\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}\quad \frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\quad \frac{\partial u}{\partial z}\quad \frac{\partial w}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\quad \frac{\partial w}{\partial z}+\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}\Big)$ $\quad \lambda = \mu$ Poisson
$\lambda = 2\mu$ Wertheim
$x' = \alpha_1 x + \beta_1 y + \gamma_1 z \qquad x = \alpha_1 x' + \alpha' y' + \alpha'' z' \qquad \frac{\partial u}{\partial x'} = \alpha\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} + \beta\frac{\partial u}{\partial y} + \gamma\frac{\partial u}{\partial z}$
$y' = \alpha'_1 x + \beta'_1 y + \gamma'_1 z \qquad y = \beta\, x'$
$z' = \alpha''_1 x + \beta''_1 y + \gamma''_1 z \qquad \gamma\, x$
$\frac{\partial u'}{\partial x'} = \alpha\frac{\partial u}{\partial x'} + \beta\frac{\partial v}{\partial x'} + \gamma\frac{\partial w}{\partial x'} = \alpha^2\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} + \beta^2\frac{\partial v}{\partial y} + \gamma^2\frac{\partial w}{\partial z} + \alpha\beta\Big(\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\Big) +$
[-$\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial v}{\partial z}$-] $\quad \frac{\partial w}{\partial x}+ \qquad \frac{\partial u'}{\partial z'}+\frac{\partial w'}{\partial x'} = 2\alpha\alpha''\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} + 2\beta\beta''\frac{\partial v}{\partial y} + 2\gamma\gamma''\frac{\partial w}{\partial z} + (\alpha\beta''+\beta\alpha'')\Big(\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\Big) +$
$\frac{\partial w'}{\partial x'} = \alpha''\frac{\partial u}{\partial x'} + \beta''\frac{\partial v}{\partial x'} + \gamma''\frac{\partial w}{\partial x'}$ $\qquad N_1 = \lambda\theta + 2\mu\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} \qquad T_1$
$\frac{\partial v}{\partial z}$
$\beta' = \cos\varphi \quad \gamma' = \sin\varphi \qquad\qquad F \quad \frac{1}{2} \quad \lambda\theta^2 + 2\mu\Big(\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}\Big)^2 + \mu\Big(\frac{\partial w}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial v}{\partial z}\Big)^2 +$
$\beta'' = -\sin\varphi \quad \gamma'' = \cos\varphi \qquad N_1\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}$
$\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} \quad \lambda\theta\,\delta\theta_1 + 2\mu$
$\frac{\partial u'}{\partial x'} = \frac{\partial u}{\partial x}$
$\frac{\partial v'}{\partial y'} = \beta'^2\frac{\partial v}{\partial y} + \gamma'^2\frac{\partial w}{\partial z} + \beta'\gamma'\Big(\frac{\partial w}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial v}{\partial z}\Big) \qquad A\Big(\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial w}{\partial z}\Big)^2 + B\Big(\Big(\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}\Big)^2 + \frac{\partial v}{\partial y}^2 + \frac{\partial w}{\partial z}^2\Big)$
$\frac{\partial w'}{\partial z'} = \beta''^2\frac{\partial v}{\partial y} + \gamma''^2\frac{\partial w}{\partial z} + \beta''\gamma''$
$\qquad + C\,\sum\Big(\frac{\partial w}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial v}{\partial z}\Big)^2$
$\frac{\partial w'}{\partial x'} + \frac{\partial u'}{\partial z'} = -\beta''\Big(\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\Big) + \gamma''\Big(\frac{\partial w}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial u}{\partial z}\Big)$
$\qquad\qquad \beta' \qquad\qquad \gamma'$
$\frac{\partial w'}{\partial y'} + \frac{\partial v'}{\partial z'} = 2\beta'\beta''\frac{\partial v}{\partial y} + 2\gamma'\gamma''\frac{\partial w}{\partial z} + (\beta'\gamma''+\gamma'\beta'')\Big(\frac{\partial w}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial v}{\partial z}\Big)$

methods.what: Variation of elastic energy as volume integral of stresses times variations of strains
methods.quote: $= \iiint \partial x\partial y\partial z \Big( N_1 \delta\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} + N_2 \delta\frac{\partial v}{\partial y} + N_3 \delta\frac{\partial w}{\partial z} + T_1 \Big(\delta\Big(\frac{\partial w}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial u}{\partial z}\Big)$

methods.what: Energy as function of the six strain components
methods.quote: $\Omega = \iiint F\Big(\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}\quad \frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\quad \frac{\partial u}{\partial z}\quad \frac{\partial w}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\quad \frac{\partial w}{\partial z}+\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}\Big)$

methods.what: Poisson and Wertheim relations between Lamé constants
Orthogonal coordinate transformation and chain rule for derivatives
methods.quote: $x' = \alpha_1 x + \beta_1 y + \gamma_1 z \qquad x = \alpha_1 x' + \alpha' y' + \alpha'' z' \qquad \frac{\partial u}{\partial x'} = \alpha\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} + \beta\frac{\partial u}{\partial y} + \gamma\frac{\partial u}{\partial z}$

methods.what: Transformation law of normal strain under rotation
methods.quote: $\frac{\partial u'}{\partial x'} = \alpha\frac{\partial u}{\partial x'} + \beta\frac{\partial v}{\partial x'} + \gamma\frac{\partial w}{\partial x'} = \alpha^2\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} + \beta^2\frac{\partial v}{\partial y} + \gamma^2\frac{\partial w}{\partial z} + \alpha\beta\Big(\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\Big) +$

methods.what: Transformation law of shear strain under rotation
methods.quote: $\frac{\partial u'}{\partial z'}+\frac{\partial w'}{\partial x'} = 2\alpha\alpha''\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} + 2\beta\beta''\frac{\partial v}{\partial y} + 2\gamma\gamma''\frac{\partial w}{\partial z} + (\alpha\beta''+\beta\alpha'')\Big(\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\Big) +$
$\lambda\theta^2 + 2\mu\Big(\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}\Big)^2 + \mu\Big(\frac{\partial w}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial v}{\partial z}\Big)^2 +$

methods.what: Rotation about the x-axis by angle φ
General quadratic energy with constants A, B, C (invariance test under rotation)
methods.quote: $A\Big(\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial w}{\partial z}\Big)^2 + B\Big(\Big(\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}\Big)^2 + \frac{\partial v}{\partial y}^2 + \frac{\partial w}{\partial z}^2\Big)$

methods.what: Transformed strains under rotation about x-axis
methods.quote: $\frac{\partial w'}{\partial y'} + \frac{\partial v'}{\partial z'} = 2\beta'\beta''\frac{\partial v}{\partial y} + 2\gamma'\gamma''\frac{\partial w}{\partial z} + (\beta'\gamma''+\gamma'\beta'')\Big(\frac{\partial w}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial v}{\partial z}\Big)$
